product.reading: Reading the controls and their evidence.

gaps.no-data: {{check}}: the product does not serve this number.
gaps.unreachable: {{check}}: the product could not be read.
gaps.no-product: No installed product proves it: add evidence by hand.
gaps.evidence-expired: The evidence added by hand has expired: add it again.

checkHints.pass: {{product}} serves a number that meets it.
checkHints.fail: {{product}} serves a number that does not meet it. Fix it there; the next read shows the change.
checkHints.no-data: {{product}} does not serve this number: it may be an older version, or have nothing to count yet.
checkHints.unreachable: {{product}} could not be read at its last read. The value is the last one read.
checkHints.not-connected: {{product}} is not among the install's products, so this check is left out of every control.

overviewPage.notReadYet: The products have not been read yet.
overviewPage.sourcesFailingDetail: Their checks keep the last values read, and the controls they prove need evidence until they are read again.
overviewPage.noSourcesDetail: Set OPENASY_PRODUCTS to the install's products, as in every product, or COMPLIANCE_SOURCES to their /metrics addresses.
overviewPage.frameworkDetail: {{failing}} failing, {{needs}} need evidence, {{na}} do not apply.
overviewPage.trendDetail: The share of controls that apply and pass, at the end of each day.
overviewPage.trendSoon: A trend after the second day
overviewPage.trendSoonDetail: Each day keeps its share of passing controls.
overviewPage.holdingBackDetail: Failing checks, by how many controls they hold back.
overviewPage.evidenceEnding: Evidence by hand: {{soon}} ends within 30 days, {{expired}} has ended
overviewPage.evidenceEndingDetail: Ended evidence no longer counts. Add the new version on the control.

controlsPage.description: Each control of the enabled frameworks, with the checks that prove it and the evidence added by hand.
controlsPage.noneDetail: Change the filters, or enable a framework.

controlPage.notFoundDetail: Its framework or reference may be wrong.
controlPage.checksDetail: Numbers read from the products. A product that is not installed is left out.
controlPage.noChecksDetail: Software cannot prove this control: add evidence by hand.
controlPage.evidenceDetail: Documents and records the checks do not cover. Each counts until its date.
controlPage.title: Title
controlPage.validUntilHint: A year from today when left empty.
controlPage.appliesDetail: To mark it as not applying, write why first: an auditor will ask.
controlPage.reasonHint: Such as: we keep no card data.

checksPage.description: Numbers each product serves at /metrics, and what they must be. Products are read every 15 minutes.
checksPage.sourcesDetail: Where each product's /metrics is, and how its last read went.

checkPage.notFoundDetail: There is no check with this name.
checkPage.last90Detail: Green when every read of the day passed, amber when some did, red when none did.

frameworksPage.description: The frameworks in scope here. A framework out of scope is left out of the lists and the overview.

settingsPage.askAnAdmin: Ask an admin of this compliance.

account.title: Account
account.description: Your profile, password, two-step verification and where you are signed in.

members.title: Members
members.description: Who can sign in to this compliance, and with which role. Viewers see everything, auditors too; editors also own controls and add evidence; admins also choose frameworks, and manage members and tokens.

signin.title: Sign-in
signin.description: Identity providers people can sign in with, such as OpenAsy Identity, Keycloak or Microsoft Entra ID, and which of their groups give which role.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.description: For scripts and CI. Each token has one role and an expiry; the secret is shown once.
